notes.title: Hell Of War на Ukrainian Games Festival 2025!
First Gameplay Teaser + 1200 Wishlists
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Commanders![/b][/p][p]Today marks an important moment — I’m releasing the first short gameplay teaser for Hell of War.
This early footage showcases one of the game’s core mechanics: controlling a drone to mark a target, calling in artillery, switching to infantry, and issuing an assault order.[/p][p]It’s just a first glimpse — more gameplay scenes are coming soon, revealing the tactical depth, combat flow, and command system at the heart of the experience.[/p][p]Also — we’ve passed 1200 wishlists on Steam!
As the solo developer, I can’t thank you enough — your support means everything.[/p][p][i]Hell of War[/i] is all about tactical freedom, decisive command, and seamless control across the battlefield.
I'm working to give the game a strong identity, unique atmosphere, and a focused vision.[/p][p]If you haven’t wishlisted yet — now’s the perfect time:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602640/Hell_Of_War/"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="mQntZ3HUSRw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]More is coming very soon — stay sharp[/p]

notes.title: 200+ Wishlists in the First Week — Thank You!
notes.content:
Hell Of War has officially passed [b]200 wishlists in the first week[/b] since our Steam page launched — and we’re incredibly grateful for your early support!

This is just the beginning.

Your support motivates every step of the development process.
